title: Handheld production A/B slot images unproven against 32GB eMMC + microSD Outcome A budgets
summary: RM121-D8E32 truth remains 32GB marketed / ~29.76 GiB usable eMMC + microSD. WP-002 Outcome A capacity math stays digitally safe only with microSD for MLP content. STREAM C remodel FAILS production image fit: device-os has no measured production slot_a/slot_b images sized to the 5.0 GiB budgets; only DEV/QEMU bootable_reference (~24 MiB combined kernel+initramfs+rootfs tree) and lab guest disks. Prefer FAIL — do not claim images fit MLP slots.
recommended_actions: OPEN: Produce sized A/B/recovery image manifests with measured bytes against Outcome A onboard placement
Keep microSD required for MLP user content — do not invent larger Radxa eMMC SKU
Do not treat alpine/debian lab guest disks as handheld factory images
